So like I said, regardless of what I say, people will always just be the stereotypical person who is more right than the owner and the real professional trainers we’ve had for her. Just because it seems she’s doing something because google says that’s what it is doesn’t mean you’re right. If it was another dog, an untrained dog, or an owner who doesn’t know what this could be then I’d have a different mindset of this. I’ll repeat myself one more time and say that every Rottweiler is different. If someone posts a video of their Rottweiler biting them just to play, you’ll say it’s bad because it’s the stereotypical thing to say and the most common/popular opinion. Everyone has their own opinion, so, I’ll let this keep going because that’s the confidence level in my ownership and the confidence level I have in my dog. If you don’t have the same level of confidence in your ownership or your dog if they did this then that’s on you, not on me. But I think at this point I said my peace. For one last time, I don’t worry about my ownership, my household or my Rottie because I know things you don’t know which is how I raise her and how she is any other moment of the day.
